commits.message:
fix(taxonomy): fix broken job-title edit layout, add edit/delete for skills and job titles

Bug report: editing a job title showed the Seniority dropdown under the
"Family" column header. Root cause -- JobTitlesTaxonomyPage's EditRow
rendered 5 <td>s while the header row and the normal (non-editing) row
both render 6 (a leading checkbox column, added when pagination/bulk-
select shipped, was never added to EditRow). Every field in edit mode
was silently shifted one column left: the title input appeared under
the checkbox header, the family dropdown under "Title", and the
seniority dropdown under "Family" -- exactly the "Family is showing
seniority options" symptom reported. Fixed by giving EditRow the same
leading empty <td> as the other two rows.

Also reported: no way to edit or delete skills, and no way to delete
job titles at all (only rename/reclassify existed). Both taxonomies
get the same edit/delete/bulk-edit surface now:

Backend (app/understanding/taxonomy/loader.py) -- new mutators,
following the exact pattern already established by
update_canonical_job_title (same advisory-lock read-modify-write,
same live-immediately-no-redeploy cache bust):
- update_canonical_skill: rename (with duplicate-collision refusal and
  the old name kept as an alias, same reasoning as job title renames)
  and/or recategorize a skill in place.
- delete_canonical_skill / delete_canonical_job_title: permanently
  remove an entry. Unlike a rename, deletion does NOT keep an alias --
  the point is that the term stops matching entirely, for a genuinely
  bad entry (a parser artifact approved by mistake, a duplicate that
  should have been an alias instead).
- bulk_delete_skills / bulk_delete_job_titles: delete several by name
  in one write.
- bulk_set_skill_category: bulk-edit, same shape as the existing
  bulk_set_job_title_family.

Endpoints (app/routers/moderation.py): PATCH /taxonomy/skills (rename/
recategorize), POST /taxonomy/skills/delete + bulk-delete + bulk-set-
category, POST /taxonomy/job-titles/delete + bulk-delete. POST rather
than DELETE for the delete actions -- skill/title names ("C++", ".NET")
are fragile to URL-encode reliably, same reasoning already applied to
the other name-bearing taxonomy endpoints in this file.

Frontend: SkillsTaxonomyPage gains the same selection checkboxes / row
edit-in-place / per-row Delete / bulk toolbar (bulk category + bulk
delete) that JobTitlesTaxonomyPage already had for family; both pages'
per-row edit forms and bulk-select-all now operate over the exact same
column layout as their normal rows, so the alignment bug above cannot
recur silently. JobTitlesTaxonomyPage additionally gets a per-row
Delete button and a "Delete selected" bulk action. All destructive
single/bulk deletes confirm via a native browser confirm() first.

New coverage in scripts/hermes-900-spam-taxonomy-check.py (18 new
checks): skill/job-title rename with alias preservation, collision
refusal, not-found handling, single delete, bulk delete, and bulk
category/family set, for both taxonomies. Full Python regression suite
run against a fresh schema and freshly built image: hermes-900 (the
script covering every change in this commit) passes all 69 checks
including the 18 new ones; the handful of unrelated pre-existing
failures (Langfuse live registry, MS Graph credentials, access-control
file) reproduce identically against the current production image in
the same throwaway harness, confirming they're missing-credential gaps
in the harness, not regressions from this change. Frontend type-checks
and builds clean.
